However, my recent experience has left me feeling frustrated and helpless.
On 4th and 7th of August 2025 I attended the A&E due to severe pain. The doctor there increased my medication dosage, prescribed additional painkillers, and requested that my GP arrange an MRI and physiotherapy treatment to address my ongoing health issues.
However, on 8th August my wife called Tredegar practice and requested a phone call from my doctor. I received a call at 3.30pm from a doctor at the practice who is offering me more painkillers and decided to cancel my MRI scan and physiotherapy treatments. This decision he made without a physical examination and was particularly upsetting.
It is concerning that a doctor could cancel a treatment plan established by another physician who had physically assessed my condition, especially when I am already in significant pain.
